# seerr_pushover_sounds (Data Source)

Get all available Pushover notification sounds from Seerr.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "seerr_pushover_sounds" "available" {}

output "pushover_sounds" {
  value = data.seerr_pushover_sounds.available.sounds
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder ID for the data source.
- `sounds` (Attributes List) List of available Pushover sounds. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sounds))

<a id="nestedatt--sounds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sounds`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) The human-readable description of the sound.
- `name` (String) The identifier name of the sound.
